source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed interim financial information 1Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-3, review report (Forvis Mazars) p.4. Units differ: the statement of profit or loss (p.8) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business, one portfolio (non-participating). Revenue 3.2.1 p.20 and reinsurance p.21 (3 months, both years). CSM roll-forward 3.3.1.2 p.26-27 (31 มีนาคม 2568); new business 3.3.1.3 p.30. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). No tax this quarter; net loss. RA release uses 3.2.1 (LRC basis, 10,492), not the AOC RA (11,620). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
